newsitem.title: USA: Medaphis is subject of SEC probe -- report.
newsitem.headline: Medaphis is subject of SEC probe -- report.

text.p: Medaphis Corp is being investigated by the Securities and Exchange Commission over stock trading activity related to two dramatic falls in its share price last year, the Atlanta Journal-Constitution reported Tuesday.

The newspaper said that in its annual filing with the SEC, the company also said the Justice Department is probing the Medaphis subsidiary Gottlieb's Financial Services, which provides business-management services to emergency room physicians.
The report quoted the company as saying it was cooperating with both investigations.
Medaphis officials were not available for comment on the report.

The SEC probe involves company projections of disappointing earnings on August 14, 1996, and October 22, 1996. The company's share price fell 60 percent and 38 percent, respectively, in the ensuing days of trading, the newspaper said.
